register_fprime_deployment(
    SOURCES
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../../../mission/Cdh/Entry.cpp"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/WstsMain.cpp"
    DEPENDS
        ${FPRIME_CURRENT_MODULE}_Top

    # simulation knows that flight software has finished what a tick caused
    CHOOSES_IMPLEMENTATIONS
        Wsts_Os_Queue
        Wsts_Os_RawTime
        Wsts_Os_Task
    # The file system of the framework, with every path of flight software mapped into the
    # sandbox of the run: `files.sandbox` in the manifest, or the files directory of the run
        Wsts_Os_File
)
# The VxWorks API shim (`shims` in the manifest), whole: any module may call it, whatever the
# order in which the static libraries are linked
target_link_libraries(${FPRIME_CURRENT_MODULE} PRIVATE "$<LINK_LIBRARY:WHOLE_ARCHIVE,Wsts_VxWorks>")
